_comment: CANDIDATE Stoa enforcement-hook registration block — NOT auto-merged into any live settings.json. install.sh deploys this file to <DEST>/.claude/templates/settings-hooks.json as a candidate ONLY. Merging it into a live .claude/settings.json ARMS the hooks, which gate real tool calls in that session; that is an explicit operator-gated step (install.sh --enable-hooks, DEFAULT OFF) that even when used targets the INSTALL TARGET, never the running build session. HARD SAFETY CONSTRAINT (design-rev1 section 8): no Stoa arc auto-writes a live settings.json. The HOOKS_DIR placeholder slot in each command path is sed-substituted at deploy time to the deployed .claude/hooks absolute path. The 'if' fields use permission-rule syntax to narrow which commands invoke each gate (the gate script then inspects tool_input.command to build its self-contained deny message). All gates FAIL-OPEN on script error. STAGE 2 (judgment tier, design-rev1 arc-50): the PostToolUse-on-Agent NOMOS-dispatch trigger and the SessionStart(compact) reprime are BEST-EFFORT — both ride the upstream-broken additionalContext channel (issues #55889 / #18427 / #15174; no fix through v2.1.150) and may not reach the model on current versions. They ship forward-compatible + harmless-when-broken; the RELIABLE carriers are the Stop self-check (decision:block+reason, a working channel) for the NOMOS reminder and CLAUDE.md + the polling cron for the post-compaction reprime. See .claude/hooks/README.md section 6. TIMEOUT NOTE: every gate uses timeout 30 EXCEPT the SessionStart(compact) reprime, which uses 10 deliberately — a compact-resume reprime must be fast or be skipped (a slow reprime would stall the resume), and it does only a cheap file read; documented in the hook header, design-rev1, and README section 4.
